title: DDR5 High-Speed Memory Module
overview: Desktop DDR5 Synchronous Dynamic Random-Access Memory module (6400 MT/s) featuring onboard PMIC voltage regulation, dual 32-bit subchannels, on-die ECC, and an anodized aluminum thermal heat spreader.
learningObjectives: Examine DDR5 onboard Power Management IC (PMIC) architecture replacing motherboard power rails
Analyze dual independent 32-bit memory subchannels doubling channel efficiency over DDR4
Trace high-frequency differential clock and command/address bus routing to DRAM silicon dies
Inspect thermal interface pads and extruded aluminum heat sink dissipation paths

components.name: 10-Layer Matte Black PCB Substrate
components.summary: High-Tg 10-layer FR-4 circuit board engineered with matched-length differential trace pairs for 6400 MT/s signal integrity.
components.howItWorks: Interconnects all DRAM chips, the PMIC, and the SPD hub to the 288-pin gold edge connector with strict impedance matching (40 ohm single-ended, 80 ohm differential).
components.whyNeeded: At multi-gigahertz transfer rates, PCB trace geometry behaves as microwave transmission lines requiring strict skew matching.
keyFacts: 288 gold-plated edge contact fingers (30 micro-inch gold)
DDR5 offset alignment key notch preventing reverse insertion
10-layer stackup with dedicated ground reference planes

components.name: 8x DDR5 DRAM Silicon Packages (16GB)
components.summary: Array of 16Gb high-density DRAM dies featuring integrated On-Die Error Correction Code (ODECC).
components.howItWorks: Stores binary bits in microscopic capacitor-transistor memory cells, refreshed dynamically every 32 milliseconds.
components.whyNeeded: Provides high-speed, volatile random access memory for running operating systems and active application workloads.
keyFacts: 16Gb per die (8 chips = 16GB total module capacity)
On-Die ECC corrects single-bit errors inside the silicon array

components.name: On-Module Power Management IC (PMIC)
components.summary: Dedicated switched-mode power regulator managing 1.1V VDD, VDDQ, and 1.8V VPP voltage domains directly on the DIMM.
components.howItWorks: Accepts bulk 5V input from the motherboard and uses integrated high-efficiency buck converters to deliver tightly regulated sub-rails directly to the DRAM dies.
components.whyNeeded: DDR5 moves power regulation from the motherboard to the module to cut voltage noise and improve overclocking stability.
keyFacts: I2C / I3C telemetry bus for voltage and current monitoring

components.name: SPD Hub & Temperature Sensor
components.summary: Serial Presence Detect EEPROM integrating thermal telemetry sensors and I3C bus interface.
components.howItWorks: Stores JEDEC timing tables and Intel XMP 3.0 / AMD EXPO profiles, communicating memory parameters to the motherboard BIOS upon boot.
components.whyNeeded: Allows plug-and-play boot configuration and automatic high-speed profile overclocking.

components.name: Anodized Aluminum Heat Spreader
components.summary: Dual-sided extruded 6063 aluminum heat plates with thermally conductive silicone adhesive tape.
components.howItWorks: Conducts thermal energy generated by the DRAM chips and PMIC across a large aluminum surface area, cooled by chassis case airflow.
components.whyNeeded: Prevents DRAM refresh rate doubling (which occurs automatically when silicon temperature exceeds 85°C).
keyFacts: Matte anodized black finish with laser-etched accents

components.name: RGB Light Diffuser Bar & Addressable LEDs
components.summary: Frosted acrylic light guide illuminated by five high-brightness addressable RGB LEDs.
components.howItWorks: Internal total reflection diffuses discrete point-source LED photons into a smooth, even light gradient along the top spine of the memory stick.
components.whyNeeded: Offers dynamic system status and illumination synchronized with motherboard lighting software.
keyFacts: Controlled via SMBus / SPD hub microcontroller

connections.label: 5.0V Bulk Motherboard DC
connections.description: 5V DC voltage provided through dedicated DIMM edge connector power pins.

connections.label: 1.1V VDD/VDDQ Power Rail
connections.description: Ultra-clean step-down regulated 1.1V rail powering the internal memory arrays and I/O buffers.

connections.label: I3C System Management Bus
connections.description: Two-wire serial management bus reading module timings and reporting internal temperature.

connections.label: Dual 32-Bit Subchannels (A & B)
connections.description: High-speed differential data buses operating at 6400 MT/s with independent command/address lines.

connections.label: Conductive Heat Dissipation
connections.description: Thermal interface pad transferring silicon package heat into the aluminum outer shroud.

connections.label: PMIC Thermal Pad Junction
connections.description: Direct thermal bridge sinking buck-converter inductor and MOSFET heat.

connections.label: ARGB LED PWM Data Line
connections.description: Digital serial color data clocked to addressable LEDs to control lighting patterns.

mechanisms.name: ARGB Diffuser Illumination
mechanisms.explanation: Smooth breathing illumination cycling across the top frosted acrylic light bar.

assemblySteps.instruction: Fabricate 10-layer FR-4 circuit board and apply immersion gold surface finish to connector fingers.
Dispense solder paste via stencil, place BGA DRAM packages, PMIC, and SPD hub, and pass through reflow oven.
Surface mount RGB LEDs on top PCB edge and snap acrylic diffuser bar into locator brackets.
Apply thermal pads over DRAM dies and PMIC, press dual aluminum heat spreaders together, and crimp locking clips.

experiments.title: PMIC Overcurrent Shutdown
experiments.consequence: Instant loss of 1.1V VDD/VDDQ rails; system crashes with immediate memory parity kernel panic.
experiments.explanation: Because DDR5 regulates memory voltage directly on the module, any PMIC protection trip cuts power to all 8 DRAM dies instantly, corrupting in-flight RAM data and causing the host processor to halt.

experiments.title: Remove Heat Spreader under Heavy Load
experiments.consequence: DRAM temperatures exceed 85°C, triggering 2x refresh rate throttling and lowering effective memory bandwidth.
experiments.explanation: DRAM capacitors leak charge exponentially faster as temperature increases. Past 85°C, the controller must double refresh cycles (tREFI drops from 7.8µs to 3.9µs), occupying the data bus and degrading game/application throughput.
